observedContract.lifetime: Native member inputs enforce session/kind/null/thread boundaries. Retained lists keep secondary documents and owners alive through managed and engine collection; host disposal invalidates wrappers, then event draining and final collection expire watched document/owner nodes.
observedContract.acquisitionAnchor: A cached native wrapper retains its first acquisition receiver. Later cache hits preserve that wrapper and original anchor. A factory-created item subsequently attached to another owner's list does not promise to retain that later owner/list by itself. When that owner dies, the engine detaches the retained item; the detached value remains usable under engine rules while the host lives. The fixture proves retained-list ownership and detached-item mutation/reattachment, not item-only retention of every later owner.
